summary: Frontend-only test for InstaBloom round 2 (Grow tab + Sticker packs + Recolor + Watermark). Grow tab, hashtag copy, caption copy, sticker packs (flowers/nature/love), sticker add, and recolor swatches all work correctly. CRITICAL BUG FOUND & FIXED: watermark modal crashed with 'Element type is invalid: got undefined' because `Circle` icon from phosphor-react-native has no deprecated alias (only exports `CircleIcon`). Applied import fix in editor.tsx: `CircleIcon as Circle`. After fix, watermark input/toggle/save flow works end-to-end (modal closes, success toast, '@myhandle' watermark renders bottom-right).

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught 'Element type is invalid' redbox on opening the watermark modal. Root cause: `Circle` imported from phosphor-react-native was undefined (only `CircleIcon` is exported for this specific icon). Fixed by importing as `CircleIcon as Circle`.

issues: Console warnings: shadow*/textShadow* style props deprecated in react-native-web; props.pointerEvents deprecated. Cosmetic.

action_items: Consider auditing other phosphor-react-native imports to migrate to *Icon aliases proactively (current codebase only had `Circle` broken); everything else uses the deprecated non-Icon export which still works but is deprecated.
(Optional carry-over) Address react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx imports rely on phosphor-react-native deprecated aliases. Latest versions only export *Icon for some icons (e.g. Circle). Recommend either pinning phosphor-react-native to a version that exports both, or migrating all icon imports to the *Icon suffix form.
Watermark handle persists via storage util (WATERMARK_KEY) and hydrates on mount — good.
Sticker recolor rail conditional `selectedId && !panel` correctly hides while sticker panel open and returns when panel closes.
All new testIDs present and correctly named (copy-hashtags-*, caption-*, sticker-pack-*, sticker-<key>, recolor-<hex>, tool-watermark, watermark-input/toggle/save-button).

success_rate.backend: not tested this round (skipped per request)
success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (Grow 5/5 packs, 8/8 captions, sticker packs 3/3 with pack switch, sticker add, recolor swatches, watermark full flow, template->editor nav)

seed_data_creation: None. Watermark handle '@myhandle' persisted in local storage during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: phosphor-react-native `Circle` icon has NO deprecated `Circle` export in current installed version — only `CircleIcon`. Any new usage of Circle icon must import as `CircleIcon as Circle` (or use `CircleIcon` directly). Other icons (Signature, CheckCircle, Palette, Flower, etc.) still export both names. Grow tab testIDs: copy-hashtags-{general|roses|spring|wedding|aesthetic}, caption-0..7. Editor testIDs added: sticker-pack-{flowers|nature|love}, sticker-{flower|lotus|tulip|cherries|leaf|plant|tree|sun|rainbow|heart|heart2|sparkle|star|crown|butterfly}, recolor-<hex>, tool-watermark, watermark-input/toggle/save-button. Reach editor via home template-card-t1.
rca_of_issue: Bug: watermark modal opens -> red screen 'Element type is invalid: expected string or class/function but got: undefined'. Reproduction: Home -> template-card-t1 -> tool-watermark. RCA: `import { Circle } from 'phosphor-react-native'` resolves to undefined because the installed phosphor-react-native only exports the icon as `CircleIcon` (unlike other icons which also export a deprecated non-Icon alias). React.createElement(undefined) throws inside the Modal render. Fix applied: change import to `CircleIcon as Circle`. Verified post-fix: modal opens, toggle icon renders, save closes modal, toast fires, watermark @handle renders at bottom-right of canvas.
